finding.summary: Dropping blank cells breaks positional/array consumers (INDEX, MATCH, VLOOKUP, TRANSPOSE, spill shape)
finding.evidence: The same `continue` in packages/sheets/src/formula/arguments.ts changes the *cardinality and position* of the cells yielded for a range, not just their values. Any consumer that relies on the yielded sequence lining up with the range's geometry — `INDEX`/`MATCH`/`VLOOKUP` offsets, `TRANSPOSE`/`SORT`/`FILTER`, and `evaluateWithSpill`'s `{ values, rows, cols }` shape used in packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts — will now see fewer values than `rows*cols` when the range contains blanks, producing shifted results or a shape mismatch when the spill is written back. The bypassing sites are the array/lookup functions in packages/sheets/src/formula/ (not in the diff); they need to keep receiving blanks (e.g. gate the skip on an aggregation flag) rather than being silently re-shaped.
